details: The animateSequence function applies transitions without calling .interrupt() first, and the Reset button neither clears the animating flag nor cancels the in-flight setTimeout chain, so clicking Reset mid-animation leaves both the animation loop and reset running concurrently with conflicting state. All other interactions are clean: force sim tick runs via D3's internal RAF-based timer, there is no cross-view dispatch, closures are stable per-panel with no stale scale references, and pointer events API is used throughout avoiding mouse/touch double-firing.
